verdict.rationale: Remote is a global payroll, EOR and contractor-management platform, so automatic year-end W-2/1099 generation and distribution is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions W-2s, 1099s, or any year-end tax-form generation or distribution. Payslip downloads and payroll data sync are related features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have W-2s and 1099s generated and distributed to workers automatically at year-end
